intro: A Lagos travel agency that plans every trip with you, one WhatsApp message at a time.
story: Prepline Travel and Tours started in Lagos in 2016 with a simple idea: planning a trip abroad should feel like chatting with a friend who knows travel. Thousands of travellers later, that is still how we work.

We plan holidays, honeymoons, family trips, church and corporate tours, and pilgrimages to more than 60 countries, and we handle visa applications for the UK, the US, Canada, the Schengen Area and more. A named planner handles your visa checklist, flights, hotels and tours, and stays on WhatsApp from the first message until you land back home.
We do not sell anything on this website. Every trip and visa application is quoted and confirmed with you directly, and you only pay once you approve your final quote.
